dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, how was the movie last night?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ wʌz ðə ˈmuːvi ˈlæst ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was so boring! I was so bored that I looked at my phone.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈbɔːrɪŋ! aɪ wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈbɔːrd ðæt aɪ ˈlʊkt ət maɪ ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? But everyone says it's exciting.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? bʌt ˈɛvriwʌn ˈsɛz ɪts ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I was excited before the movie, but it was very disappointing.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ wʌz ɪkˈsaɪtɪd bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈmuːvi, bʌt ɪt wʌz ˈvɛri ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. Fah was frightened, but I wasn't.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈfɑː wʌz ˈfraɪtənd, bʌt aɪ ˈwʌzənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'm sorry you were disappointed. Do you want to see a movie with me on Friday?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri juː wɜːr ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪd. duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈsiː ə ˈmuːvi wɪð miː ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: A new movie about a dog. People say it's really exciting.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈnuː ˈmuːvi əˈbaʊt ə ˈdɔːɡ. ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ɪts ˈriːli ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. I hope it isn't boring!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. aɪ ˈhoʊp ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈbɔːrɪŋ!
